title: VoxelGI "Bake" button silently no-ops when node is under a locked parent — no error or warning shown
body: ### Tested versions Godot v4.6.3.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) ### System information Godot v4.6.3.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9636) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700K (20 threads) - 31.74 GiB memory ### Issue description Clicking the Bake button on a VoxelGI node that is a child of a locked parent completes instantly with no output and produces no baked data. No warning, toast notification, or console error is shown. The operation appears to succeed. Expected behavior: The editor should detect that the node or its data resource cannot be saved due to a locked ancestor and show a clear message, e.g.: "Cannot bake: VoxelGI is under a locked parent. Move it to an unlocked node or unlock the parent first." Actual behavior: Bake completes instantly and silently. The user has no way to know why it failed. This causes significant confusion and wasted debugging time. Severity: Silent failure on a bake operation — the user has no indication anything went wrong. ### Steps to reproduce Add a VoxelGI node to the scene and assign a VoxelGIData resource to it Place the VoxelGI node under a parent node that is locked (right-click → Lock) Click the Bake button in the VoxelGI toolbar Bake finishes in ~1 second with no result and no data written ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
